1.w: For the music director, written by the Korahites, a psalm. O Lord , you showed favor to your land; you restored the well-being of Jacob.

2.w: You pardoned the wrongdoing of your people; you forgave all their sin. (Selah)

3.w: You withdrew all your fury; you turned back from your raging anger.

4.w: Restore us, O God our deliverer. Do not be displeased with us.

5.w: Will you stay mad at us forever? Will you remain angry throughout future generations?

6.w: Will you not revive us once more? Then your people will rejoice in you.

7.w: O Lord , show us your loyal love. Bestow on us your deliverance.

8.w: I will listen to what God the Lord says. For he will make peace with his people, his faithful followers. Yet they must not return to their foolish ways.

9.w: Certainly his loyal followers will soon experience his deliverance; then his splendor will again appear in our land.

10.w: Loyal love and faithfulness meet; deliverance and peace greet each other with a kiss.

11.w: Faithfulness grows from the ground, and deliverance looks down from the sky.

12.w: Yes, the Lord will bestow his good blessings, and our land will yield its crops.

13.w: Deliverance goes before him, and prepares a pathway for him.
